page.layout: One page of text, one column, no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Religionis vincula, in necessaria officia obli-garunt.

Neque video quo pacto conciliare possunt Innovans hoc Fœdus, & Juramentum, cum nuperâ illâ suâ Protestatione, quâ tueri susceperant Religionem in Ecclesia Anglicana Sancitam; istî præsertim qui Discipli-nam inter Momenta Religionis accensent.

Sed nunquam nimis se credunt Ambi-tiosi homines, laqueos, & tendiculas hu-jusmodi vulgi credulitati struxisse: his enim fere actibus, & pietatis suco arctius qua-runt sibi populum obstringere, metu scilicet perjurii intentato; cum revera probi omnes & prudentes, satis se jam diu ligamentis suis prioribus, Religionis, Fidelitatis, Legum, Deo juxta & Hominibus obstrictos putarent.

Quæ quidem tanta sunt, ut nulla po-sterior stipulatio, ( excogitata & imperata à paucis hominibus in aperta Factione versantibus, absque meo Consensu, & nullo simili Exemplo præeunte, vel potestate à Divinis vel Humanis Legibus derivata ) satis unquam videatur cordatis hominibus, vel solvendo, vel relaxando moralia illa & æterna obsequii vincula quæ & Deo & Mihi præstanda, subditorum conscientiis incumbunt.
Nunc verò, ( prout res se habent ) minus Deo & Mihi displicebunt boni Viri, si fi[?]

page.notes: Running head is Greek (ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ). The word at the end of the last line ("fi") is a custos (a catchword set beside the line) and is doubtful. The catchword "Fædas" is doubtful. Possible italics in the body text are set from the scan and may be inexact. "hu-jusmodi" is read with the long s as f, as printed.
